headlines.title: Lumentum Fell to $750 With Marvell’s Offer Worth $820. Its November 5 Report Tests the Floor
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell to $750 on Monday after agreeing to an all-stock sale to Marvell for 4. 5 Marvell shares apiece, which were worth $820 at Marvell’s price then.

headlines.title: Lumentum Sinks 10% With Marvell as Blue Wave Hits Data-Center Stocks: “Premium Can Quickly Go Negative”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 10% today as AI data-center stocks sold off after the election, with Marvell and Coherent down too. Marvell is paying in its own stock, so every drop in Marvell’s shares cuts what Lumentum holders get.

headlines.title: Marvell's Deal to Acquire Lumentum Could Be a Game Changer for the Stock
headlines.summary: Marvell's acquisition of Lumentum will create an optical networking juggernaut.

headlines.title: What Does Marvell Technology (MRVL) Gain From A $115 Billion All Stock Deal?
headlines.summary: Marvell Technology (NasdaqGS:MRVL) announced a US$115b all-stock acquisition of Lumentum Holdings on 4 November 2026. The transaction is structured entirely in equity, with Lumentum shareholders set to receive Marvell stock instead of cash. Management highlighted optical technologies for AI data center infrastructure as a key rationale for combining the two businesses. Beyond the proposed US$115b all-stock purchase of Lumentum, Marvell Technology’s broader story deserves a closer look.

headlines.title: Bloom Energy Sinks 8%, Lumentum Down 11% as AI Power Stocks Fade After Democrat Sweep
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy fell 8% as AI stocks sold off after Democrats swept Tuesday’s elections, and Lumentum and MARA Holdings fell with it. Data center contractors fell even more, a sign investors fear fewer data centers will get built, which would hurt Bloom too.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
